verses.1: The song of praise remembers Jehovah to David of all his answers.
verses.2: Whoever praises the LORD, will be strong in his service to Jacob.
verses.3: If I enter the temple of my house, if I climb up the steps leading to it.
verses.4: If I can give them two years of time for my eyes to rest.
verses.5: I haven’t found a place for Jehovah to dwell among the homes of Jacob’s servants.
verses.6: Look, we heard her voice in Ephratah; we found her in the forests of Yael.
verses.7: I will enter his dwelling place, and I will bow down before the blood on his feet.
verses.8: May the LORD come to your place of rest. You and your chariot!
verses.9: Your priests shall walk in righteousness, and your believers shall be blessed.
verses.10: After David has served you, do not turn away from your Messiah.
verses.11: The LORD will not return to David, for truly, he will never return from his place. From the fruit of your womb, I will make a sacrifice for your altar.
verses.12: If your children keep my covenant and my laws, then they will also be taught these laws from generation to generation, until they sit on the throne.
verses.13: For Jehovah has chosen Zion as his dwelling place.
verses.14: This is my resting place, forever and ever, since she has gone to rest there.
verses.15: May she be blessed by her ancestors. May they bless her with peace and prosperity.
verses.16: And her priests will be Alvis Yeshua, and her righteous ones will be Ranen Yeranenu.
verses.17: There I will set up a lampstand for David; I will make it a light for my Messiah.
verses.18: Oh, how ugly and disgusting it is! And on top of that, there’s also a nazar.
